$comment: What can go wrong with Agent Graph, and how to fix it: shared by `agent-graph diagnostics` (compiled in: src/diagnostics.rs names each problem by its id) and the site's /troubleshooting page, where each is at #<id>. `fix` is what to do anywhere; `clouds` has what to do instead in a cloud, by the name `agent-graph` gives it. `Backticks` mark code.

issues.title: Cursor runs none of the hooks in a hooks file
issues.problem: Cursor reads `hooks.json` as JSON with comments: a `//` or `/*` anywhere in a hook's command (`https://…`, say) starts a "comment" that breaks the file, and Cursor then runs none of its hooks, without saying so. agent-graph 0.1.20's `install cursor --cloud` wrote such a command.
issues.fix: Install the hooks again with agent-graph 0.1.21 or later (`agent-graph install cursor`, or for the cloud, `agent-graph install cursor --cloud --scope project`, then commit `.cursor/hooks.json`). A hook of your own with `//` in its command needs it written another way: in `sh`, `https:/''/example.com` is still `https://example.com`.

issues.title: A hooks or settings file isn't valid JSON
issues.problem: The agent can't read the file its hooks are in, so it runs none of them.
issues.fix: Open the file named in the report and fix the JSON (a missing comma or quote, usually). Installing again won't change a file it can't read.

issues.title: An agent has no Agent Graph hooks
issues.problem: The agent is installed on this computer, but nothing records its sessions.
issues.fix: Run `agent-graph install claude-code` (or `codex`, or `cursor`), then start a new session: sessions already running aren't recorded.

clouds.Claude Code cloud: On your computer, in the repository, run `agent-graph install claude-code --cloud`, commit `.claude/settings.json` and push it to the branch cloud sessions start from, then start a new session.
clouds.Codex cloud: Edit the environment at chatgpt.com/codex: its setup script needs both lines from the site's Codex cloud steps. Click Reset cache, and start a new task.
clouds.Cursor cloud: On your computer, in the repository, run `agent-graph install cursor --cloud --scope project`, commit `.cursor/hooks.json` and push it to the branch cloud agents start from, then start a new agent.

issues.title: A hook runs a program that isn't there
issues.problem: An Agent Graph hook names an `agent-graph` that's been moved or deleted (an upgrade by another route, or a build folder cleaned), so it does nothing.
issues.fix: Run `agent-graph install <agent>` again with the `agent-graph` you use now: it points the hooks at it.

issues.title: Codex doesn't trust Agent Graph's hooks
issues.problem: Codex runs a hook only once it's trusted in its `config.toml`, and these aren't (or were changed since they were trusted).
issues.fix: Run `agent-graph install codex` again, which trusts them, then restart Codex (and the ChatGPT app, with Cmd+Q).

issues.title: Nothing has been recorded
issues.problem: Agent Graph's hooks are in place, but no session has been recorded: the agent hasn't started a session since, or its hooks aren't running.
issues.fix: Start a new session in the agent (one already running isn't recorded). Still nothing? Run `agent-graph diagnostics` again: it names whatever stops the hooks.

clouds.Claude Code cloud: The hooks come from the repository: check `.claude/settings.json` with the cloud hooks is committed on the branch the session started from (`agent-graph install claude-code --cloud`), and start a new session.
clouds.Codex cloud: The environment's setup script installs the hooks: check it has both lines from the site's Codex cloud steps, click Reset cache on the environment's page, and start a new task.
clouds.Cursor cloud: The hooks come from the repository: check `.cursor/hooks.json` with the cloud hooks is committed on the branch the agent started from (`agent-graph install cursor --cloud --scope project`), and start a new agent.

issues.title: The cloud agent started from an older commit
issues.problem: A cloud agent works on a copy of the repository, which can start behind its branch (a cloud may restore an older copy, then catch up). The agent's hooks are read from the copy it starts with, so hooks committed since don't run, or run only later.
issues.fix: Check the agent starts on the branch with the hooks, and that the branch is pushed. Then start a new agent: one that starts on the latest commit runs the hooks from its first message.

clouds.Cursor cloud: A Cursor cloud agent starts from its environment's saved copy of the repository, which can be older than your latest push. In Cursor, set the environment's Start Script to `git pull --ff-only`, so each agent brings it up to date first, then start a new agent.

issues.title: Cursor cloud agents are named by their repository
issues.problem: A Cursor cloud agent's machine has no Cursor database to read its name from. Agent Graph asks the machine's own metadata (Cursor's Agent Metadata Socket) instead, which Cursor's own cloud machines have, once Cursor has named the agent. A machine without it (one of your own, say) names its agents by their repository.
issues.fix: Nothing to do on Cursor's cloud machines: the name comes once Cursor has given one. Elsewhere, Cursor's API can say it, with a Cursor API key: make one in Cursor's dashboard and add it as a secret named `CURSOR_API_KEY`. The agent can read it, as it can any secret, and it can do whatever your Cursor API key can: leave it out if you'd rather.

issues.title: Agent Graph can't write its data folder
issues.problem: Sessions are recorded in `~/.agent-graph` (or `$AGENT_GRAPH_HOME`), and that folder can't be made or written to.
issues.fix: Check the folder's owner and permissions (`ls -ld ~/.agent-graph`), or set `AGENT_GRAPH_HOME` to a folder you can write to.

issues.title: The site can't be reached
issues.problem: Sharing sends what's recorded to the site, and nothing answers there: no network, a firewall, or a proxy in the way.
issues.fix: Check this computer can open the site in a browser. Behind a proxy, `HTTPS_PROXY` must be set for `agent-graph` too.

clouds.Claude Code cloud: In the environment's settings at claude.ai/code, set network access to Custom, allowing `agentgraph.chofter.com` and `firebasestorage.googleapis.com`.
clouds.Codex cloud: In the environment's settings at chatgpt.com/codex, turn on Agent internet access, add `agentgraph.chofter.com` to the additional allowed domains, and allow all HTTP methods.
clouds.Cursor cloud: A cloud agent's machine can usually reach the internet: check your team's network settings in Cursor's dashboard allow `agentgraph.chofter.com`.

issues.title: Something else answered for the site
issues.problem: A request to the site got an answer, but not the site's: a proxy's page, or a network that blocks it.
issues.fix: Allow the site through the proxy or firewall, for every HTTP method (sharing sends with POST).

clouds.Codex cloud: In the environment's settings at chatgpt.com/codex, set Allowed HTTP Methods to All methods.

issues.title: AGENT_GRAPH_TOKEN isn't set
issues.problem: In a cloud, sharing logs in with an API token from your account page, given as `AGENT_GRAPH_TOKEN`, and there's none.
issues.fix: Make a token on the site's account page, under API tokens, and set `AGENT_GRAPH_TOKEN` to it.

clouds.Claude Code cloud: At claude.ai/code, open the environment's settings and add `AGENT_GRAPH_TOKEN=agt_…` under environment variables, then start a new session.
clouds.Codex cloud: At chatgpt.com/codex, edit the environment and add `AGENT_GRAPH_TOKEN` under Environment variables (not Secrets, which only the setup script gets), then start a new task.
clouds.Cursor cloud: At cursor.com/dashboard, open Cloud Agents, then Secrets, and add `AGENT_GRAPH_TOKEN`, then start a new agent.

issues.title: The login isn't one the site knows
issues.problem: The token (`AGENT_GRAPH_TOKEN`, or this computer's saved login) has been revoked or deleted on the account page, or was mistyped.
issues.fix: Make a new token on the account page, under API tokens, and use it in place of the old one. On your own computer, `agent-graph watch-remote` logs in again.

clouds.Claude Code cloud: Replace `AGENT_GRAPH_TOKEN` in the environment's settings at claude.ai/code with a new token, then start a new session.
clouds.Codex cloud: Replace `AGENT_GRAPH_TOKEN` in the environment's variables at chatgpt.com/codex with a new token, click Reset cache, and start a new task.
clouds.Cursor cloud: Replace the `AGENT_GRAPH_TOKEN` secret in Cursor's dashboard (Cloud Agents → Secrets) with a new token, then start a new agent.

issues.title: This computer isn't logged in
issues.problem: Recording works without an account; sharing to the site needs this computer logged in.
issues.fix: Run `agent-graph watch-remote`: it opens the site to log in, then shares.

issues.title: Nothing is sharing
issues.problem: This computer is logged in, but `agent-graph watch-remote` isn't running, so the site shows nothing new.
issues.fix: Run `agent-graph watch-remote`, or `agent-graph watch-remote --autostart` to have it start whenever you log in.

clouds.Claude Code cloud: The cloud's `SessionStart` hook starts sharing: check the cloud hooks are committed (`agent-graph install claude-code --cloud`), and start a new session.
clouds.Codex cloud: The session's first hook starts sharing: check the environment's setup script has both lines from the site's Codex cloud steps, click Reset cache, and start a new task.
clouds.Cursor cloud: A turn's first hook starts sharing: check `.cursor/hooks.json` with the cloud hooks is committed, and send the agent another message. `~/.agent-graph/watch-remote.log` says why it stopped.

issues.title: Sharing stopped
issues.problem: `agent-graph watch-remote` started, then stopped with an error (the report has it).
issues.fix: Fix what the error names, then run `agent-graph watch-remote` again.

clouds.Claude Code cloud: Fix what the error names, then start a new session.
clouds.Codex cloud: Fix what the error names, then start a new task.
clouds.Cursor cloud: Fix what the error names, then send the agent another message: its first hook starts sharing again.

issues.title: Installing agent-graph in the cloud failed
issues.problem: The cloud's first hook installs agent-graph from the site's install script, and that failed (its output is in the report).
issues.fix: Check the cloud can reach the site and download from Firebase Storage (`firebasestorage.googleapis.com`), then start a new session.

issues.title: A newer agent-graph is out
issues.problem: A newer release fixes problems this one has.
issues.fix: Upgrade the way you installed it: `brew upgrade --cask chofter/tap/agent-graph`, `npm update -g @chofter/agent-graph`, or the install script again.

clouds.Claude Code cloud: The cloud installs the latest release itself, in each new session.
clouds.Codex cloud: Click Reset cache on the environment's page, so its setup script installs the latest release.
clouds.Cursor cloud: The cloud installs the latest release itself, on each new agent's machine.
